integrity: Complete coefficientwise finite checker on nine blade vectors; general statements proved by an explicit exhaustive structural case analysis and iid limiting argument.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to graph-continuous partial maps on one-hub unions of complete blades; fixed blade-size asymptotics only. General idempotent fiber lemma and star enumeration are prior mathematics; priority remains provisional.
title: Clique-windmill idempotent rank laws and Gaussian concentration
